deliverables.parity_definition: An operation has parity only when Python and .NET expose its semantic ID/profile, accept equivalent canonical effective inputs, produce the same result-state meaning and provenance, and match independently qualified expected values within PF7 tolerances. Internal algorithms and idiomatic names may differ.

operations.parity_evidence: common conformance vectors plus independent expected values
common raw-source fixture and normalized action snapshot; ETABS acquisition itself excluded
portable captured snapshot replayed by both libraries; live installed evidence applies to adapter only
complete member/construction/search vectors with deterministic ordering
common transaction request/receipt schema plus installed .NET ETABS evidence
workbook rows replay common operations; installed Excel evidence proves the projection
same calculation-package semantic data; rendered byte/layout equality is not required
versioned workload and installed Excel measurements

deliverables.application_boundary_rule: An Excel/ETABS command may be implemented only in the supported .NET Windows adapter while its immutable request, snapshot, receipt and reusable engineering results remain portable. Application-specific parity means contract/replay parity, not a Python COM clone.

namespaces.name: structural_lib.compat
depends_on: all normative public packages but no adapter

deliverables.projection_policy: Existing structural_lib.services callers migrate through thin orchestration or compatibility modules. New pure domain work follows the namespace direction above and cannot import FastAPI, React, Excel, CSI COM or file-rendering state.

assemblies.name: StructuralEngineering.Reporting
owns: calculation-package semantic records and render interfaces

assemblies.name: StructuralEngineering.ExcelDna
owns: XLL functions, ribbon/panel commands, bulk range conversion and workbook receipts

assemblies.name: StructuralEngineering.Etabs
owns: CSI interop, acquisition, source mapping and copied-model transaction

deliverables.physical_packaging_note: PF9 may combine related assemblies into a small number of NuGet packages, but it cannot merge namespace responsibilities or introduce reverse dependencies.
deliverables.projection_policy: The pure NuGet library graph loads without Excel-DNA or CSI assemblies. Windows adapter packages reference the pure graph; the pure graph never references adapters.

authored_authorities.owns: purpose, quantities, applicability, field obligations, result meanings, provenance and compatibility
strict portable field structure, types, enum tokens and schema versions
approved tables/lookup nodes and source provenance within an operation scope
canonical inputs, expected states/values, tolerance identifiers and evidence references
semantic ID to Python and .NET names/types

handwritten_language_artifacts: adapter implementations and application error translation
generated_artifacts: transport DTOs or serializers where generation is proven stable
rules: Generation flows from reviewed semantic/schema/data authorities; generated C# or Python code cannot become the only definition of meaning.
Generated output is reproducible and checked for an empty regeneration diff.
Strict calculation boundaries reject unknown major-version fields. A compatibility/migration layer may explicitly translate known older contracts.
Every exchange includes schema_version and operation_semantic_id; engineering work additionally binds profile_id and code_data_revision_id.
Equivalent payloads canonicalize through PF4-CANONICAL-JSON-V1 in both languages.
Binary rendered reports, internal object layouts and exception text are outside semantic parity.

version_negotiation.major: reject unless an explicit translator is registered
version_negotiation.minor: accept only when declared compatible and all unknown optional fields are outside engineering meaning
version_negotiation.patch: accept when field structure and semantics are unchanged
version_negotiation.code_data: exact revision required for calculation/result replay

controls.evidence: FO01-FO08 and AO01-AO26 each have one semantic manifest and language projection or explicit adapter-only disposition
generate maintained projections twice and require no diff
both languages accept every valid fixture and reject every invalid fixture with equivalent diagnostic codes
both languages produce identical canonical bytes/digests for common effective inputs
both languages match independently qualified expected outcomes under PF7 tolerances
both packaged artifacts expose the same normalized data revision and digest
architecture checks reject pure-package references to Excel-DNA, CSI, UI or web layers
published legacy fixtures translate to the named semantic operation or a documented unsupported outcome
captured ETABS snapshots and workbook tables replay through the common library without live hosts
Python wheel, NuGet packages and XLL receipt list semantic/schema/data/build versions

deliverables.gate_rule: A common operation cannot be released in one language as parity-complete while any applicable DRIFT-01 through DRIFT-06 control is missing or failing.

evidence: PF6-D1 assigns FO01-FO08 and AO01-AO26 a parity mode/evidence, and defines parity by canonical inputs, semantic states and PF7 tolerances.

exit_evidence.criterion: Schema generation cannot redefine handwritten domain meaning.
evidence: PF6-D4 separates authored semantic/schema/data authorities, handwritten algorithms and generated transport projections.

exit_evidence.criterion: Vendor details remain in adapter packages.
evidence: PF6-D2/D3 isolate Excel-DNA and CSI dependencies; AO16/AO22/AO23/AO25 are adapter modes over portable contracts.
